P1para.Text: A person must not carry on a regulated activity in the United Kingdom, or purport to do so, unless he is an authorised person or an exempt person.

P2para.Text: The prohibition in this section applies to a person who is not an authorised person and is not exempt.

P3para.Text: This includes a person acting as a principal in the course of business.

P1para.Text: A person must not, in the course of business, communicate an invitation or inducement to engage in investment activity.
The Authority may give a person a direction under this section if it appears that the person has contravened a requirement.

P2para.Text: A direction under this section may require the person to take specified steps.
